verdict.rationale: Vanta's docs confirm an OpenAPI specification exists: its official SDKs are generated from it, and the API reference has a server dropdown typical of spec-driven docs. No evidence shows users can download that spec, and probes of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known) all returned 404. missing for 10: a documented, publicly downloadable OpenAPI/spec URL, coverage of the Manage Vanta API spec beyond the Auditor API, hands-on confirmation of retrieval.
